snippet.title: PLINTH - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A gravity-agnostic puzzle game where your PLINTH sticks to every surface. Tip over edges, up walls and across ceilings in search of the exit. Solve it alone, work it out with a friend, or build puzzles of your own. 

🧱 Wishlist PLINTH on Steam: https://midnighte.rs/plinth-steam

This trailer was a part of ✨Midnight Screening 2026✨ a showcase of new games, demo drops and trailers! Check out the full lineup here: https://youtu.be/FFpPlTp4eyo

See the full Midnighters lineup on our website: http://www.midnighters.games
